text: Take Science with Physics, Chemistry and Biology (PCB) and English.
Write NEET-UG, the national medical entrance exam conducted by the National Testing Agency (NTA).
MBBS at a college recognised by the National Medical Commission, including a compulsory internship.
To specialise (for example surgery, paediatrics, psychiatry), write NEET-PG and do an MD, MS or DNB.
Take Science with PCB and English.
Write NEET-UG (National Testing Agency).
BDS at a college recognised by the Dental Council of India, including an internship. An MDS lets you specialise.
Take Science with PCB and English.
Admission is through state or institute entrance tests; some colleges use NEET-UG scores. Check each college.
B.Sc Nursing (or the shorter GNM diploma) at an institution recognised by the Indian Nursing Council, then register with your State Nursing Council.
An M.Sc Nursing lets you specialise or teach.
Take Science with Physics, Chemistry and Biology or Maths.
B.Pharm (degree) or D.Pharm (diploma) at an institution approved by the Pharmacy Council of India, then register with your State Pharmacy Council.
Take Science with PCB.
Bachelor of Physiotherapy (BPT), including a clinical internship. Admission is through state or university entrance tests.
Take Science with PCB.
NEET-UG for the all-India quota, or your state's entrance test for state veterinary colleges.
B.V.Sc & A.H. (Bachelor of Veterinary Science and Animal Husbandry), including an internship.
Take Science with Physics, Chemistry and Maths (PCM).
JEE Main (NTA) for NITs, IIITs and many colleges; JEE Advanced for IITs; or your state's engineering entrance test.
B.E. or B.Tech in the branch you want (civil, mechanical, electrical, chemical ...).
After Class 10, a 3-year polytechnic diploma; diploma holders can often join a B.Tech directly in the second year (lateral entry).
GATE is used for M.Tech admissions and many public-sector jobs.
Join an ITI trade course (for example electrician, fitter, mechanic) or a polytechnic diploma.
Do an apprenticeship with a company to get on-the-job experience.
Science with Maths (PCM) is needed for B.Tech; for BCA many colleges accept any stream with Maths.
B.Tech in Computer Science or IT (through JEE Main or state tests), or BCA / B.Sc Computer Science followed by an MCA.
Build projects, take part in hackathons and do internships; employers look closely at what you have built.
Take Maths.
B.Sc or B.Tech in Statistics, Maths or Computer Science; a master's degree helps for research roles.
Learn programming (Python or R) and statistics, and do projects with real data.
Any stream.
CLAT for the National Law Universities (other tests such as AILET are used by some universities).
A 5-year integrated BA LLB (or BBA LLB) after Class 12, or a 3-year LLB after any graduation.
Enrol with a State Bar Council and pass the All India Bar Examination to practise. Judicial services exams lead to becoming a judge.
Commerce is the usual stream, but any stream can register.
Register with ICAI and clear CA Foundation, CA Intermediate, practical training (articleship) and CA Final.
B.Com, then roles in accounting; related professional courses: Company Secretary (ICSI) and Cost and Management Accountant (ICMAI).
Any bachelor's degree (BBA, B.Com, B.Tech, BA ...).
CAT for the IIMs and many business schools; other schools use their own tests.
MBA or PGDM, ideally after some work experience; most managers first work in the field they later manage.
Any stream.
NIFT entrance (fashion), NID DAT, UCEED (IIT Bombay) and university design tests.
B.Des in your area (fashion, communication, interior, product).
Build a portfolio of your work; it matters as much as the degree.
Take Physics, Chemistry and Maths.
NATA (Council of Architecture) or JEE Main Paper 2.
B.Arch, then register with the Council of Architecture to practise.
Theatre groups, acting or film workshops, and film institutes such as FTII (Pune), SRFTI (Kolkata) and the National School of Drama (theatre).
Degrees in mass communication, film studies or performing arts help but are not required.
Assist on sets, make short films, build a showreel and audition regularly.
BA in Journalism and Mass Communication (BJMC), or any degree followed by a diploma such as the one at IIMC.
Write regularly, intern with newspapers, channels or websites, and keep a portfolio of published work.
Any stream.
NCHM JEE (conducted by NTA) for the Institutes of Hotel Management; private institutes have their own admission.
B.Sc in Hospitality and Hotel Administration, or a diploma in culinary arts; then kitchen or hotel training.
A bachelor's degree in the subject you want to teach, then a B.Ed; or an integrated teacher-education programme after Class 12.
Clear CTET (central schools) or your state's TET to teach in schools.
A master's degree in your subject.
Clear UGC-NET (conducted by NTA) and/or complete a PhD.
BA or B.Sc in Psychology, then an MA or M.Sc in Psychology.
Clinical psychologists need a programme recognised by the Rehabilitation Council of India (RCI) and RCI registration.
BSW (Bachelor of Social Work), then an MSW for most professional roles.
State police recruitment exams (constable after Class 12, sub-inspector after graduation); IPS through the UPSC Civil Services Examination after graduation.
NDA examination (UPSC) after Class 12; CDS examination (UPSC) after graduation; technical and other entries are listed on the official recruitment sites.
Take Physics and Maths.
Pass the DGCA medical, train at a DGCA-approved flying school and earn a Commercial Pilot Licence (CPL).
Science with Biology or Maths (some states also offer Agriculture as a subject).
B.Sc Agriculture (or Horticulture, Food Technology) at an agricultural university; admission through CUET-UG for ICAR seats or state tests (check ICAR).
Farmers can learn new methods through Krishi Vigyan Kendra trainings in their district.
Certificate or diploma course in cosmetology, hair styling, make-up or skin care.
Train in a salon, build a portfolio of your work and get a skill certificate.
Fitness certifications, or a B.P.Ed / B.P.E.S degree; coaching diplomas are offered by the Sports Authority of India.
